title: 4.12 She swims twice a week
unit_title: Life at home, every day and yesterday
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, talk about the lights and machines, ask what there is, describe someone's morning in order, say what you did yesterday and on which day, ask and tell the time, say how often you do things and give dates.
goal: Say how often people do things with once a week, twice a week and every weekend (How often does Ana swim? She swims twice a week.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 4.12 Tomorrow and the Week: A1 names the days of a week, the weekend, the months and the year on a calendar; A1+ 4.12 counts in them how often people do things, answering 1.7's How often…? The new items are once a week, twice a week and every weekend at the end of the sentence (Diego runs once a week.), after 1.6's frequency words before the verb (Diego sometimes paints.). How often cannot be photographed: each photo shows who does what (A1+ 1.3's swimming and running, 1.8's cooking and TV, 3.14's painting), a picture bank changes only the activity or the person, and Listen sets the frequencies against each other and against 4.9's past with a day.
prerequisite: A1 4.12 week, weekend; A1+ 1.6 always, usually, sometimes, never; A1+ 1.7 How often…?; A1+ 1.3 swims, runs.
speaking_outcome: Say once (WUNS) and twice (TWAIS) with a clear s and link a week (uh-WEEK); every weekend stresses WEEK. Do not require native-like speed.
